name: Ultrapods Pro TWS Earbuds
subtitle: Transparent earbuds with LED battery display
description: These transparent-design TWS earbuds feature 13mm bass drivers, Bluetooth 5.3, ENC, and a charging case with LED battery display. They provide up to 30 hours of playtime with the case, while built-in microphones support hands-free calls and voice assistant use.
story: The transparent charging case gives this earbud set a distinctive appearance while keeping its battery indicator easy to view. For everyday listening, the combination of Bluetooth 5.3 and touch controls supports wireless playback and call management. The case extends total playtime to up to 30 hours, with fast charging listed for convenient recharging. ENC is included for calls, and the earbuds also support voice assistant access through their built-in microphone and controls.

specs.playtime: Up to 30 hours with charging case
specs.display: LED battery level indicator on case
specs.controls: Touch controls for playback and calls
specs.microphone: Built-in mic for calls and voice assistant

shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
